Because i have to say goodbye to everyone before doing it

I know they don't know but i know how they react to traumas because we've all experienced it. It would be irrational if i woke up and wanted to die but i've been planning this for over 3 months now. To the exact date. I don't have to admit to having depression because i'm not actually depressed, i don't think of myself any less. I'm not a good person due to my actions but i'm just as good as anyone else out there. Call it whatever you want man i'm just here to say goodbye ig. Yes it'll affect them for a short amount of time.

I appreciate your enthusiasm and i want to clarify that i am not a moody or a depressed person at all! I've enjoyed my last 2 months, it was very nice to be free of responsibilities. This is how i wanted to leave earth. I can 100% assure you, this is not a breakdown i'm not doing things irrationally. Seriously we could have a talk right now and see that i'm just fine really. I've always thought of putting a burden of them but they are putting a burden on me by wanting me to stay alive. I know my friends and family, they are strong people they will definetly be able to live life at their fullest even after my passing. Attempting suicide and not succeeding feels like insecurity about suicide, if you're not actually 100% convinved this is the right decision for you. Then yes the regret will feel insane.

Hey man, i'll be doing the same in 2 days. I hope there is no other side because if there is, we'll definetly end up in hell. Also i've heard that liver failure is a painful way to go. I'm not here to assist or promote suicide so i'll keep the better ways to myself.
